lede: Wake Forest carries a full EdgeDesk team rating at +10.9; Merrimack is not one of the 138 FBS programmes EdgeDesk rates, so the comparison is one-sided by construction rather than by judgement.
EdgeDesk makes it Wake Forest −43.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Wake Forest winning >99% of simulations.

The roster and position-group comparison below explains where EdgeDesk’s separation comes from on the side it can measure; Merrimack is absent from the FBS player dataset, so the exact size of that gap is not established.
Data confidence on this matchup is 59% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
